name: A Taste of Flame

aliases: who gives a taste of flame
faq.answer: Cyrus Therepentous sends you to claim the giant's heat and expects the encased essence returned to him.
faq.q: Who wants the essence of Bael'Gar?

faq.answer: Bael'Gar resides deep within the halls of Blackrock Depths.

aliases: how to use altered black dragonflight molt
faq.answer: You must use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt directly upon Bael'Gar's remains after defeating him.
faq.q: How do you capture the fiery essence?

faq.answer: Cyrus provides an Altered Black Dragonflight Molt, a specialized dragon skin treated to withstand and capture the fiery core of the giant.
faq.q: What is used to contain the essence?

sections.body: Cyrus Therepentous directs your gaze toward the fiery depths beneath the mountain. Somewhere within Blackrock Depths dwells the massive giant Bael'Gar, whose body burns with immense heat. Cyrus has entrusted you with an Altered Black Dragonflight Molt, crafted specifically to absorb that living flame once the creature falls. Slaying the giant is only half the burden, for the skin must be used upon his smoldering remains before the heat escapes.
sections.title: The Molt and the Giant

summary: Cyrus Therepentous seeks the burning heart of a subterranean colossus. You must venture into Blackrock Depths, slay the giant Bael'Gar, and entrap his fiery essence within an altered dragon skin.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Taste of Flame
